tagline.zh-Hant: 一座伐木的山，怎麼變成森林遊樂區
tagline.en: How a logging mountain became a forest park

zh: 宜蘭縣大同鄉的太平山，
舊稱「眠腦」，是泰雅族語「鬱鬱蒼蒼」的意思。
en: Taipingshan in Datong, Yilan
was once called Minnao, Atayal for dense, flourishing forest.

zh: 這片山林以紅檜與扁柏聞名，
一百多年來，故事都繞著樹打轉。
en: These forests are known for red cypress and Taiwan cypress;
for more than a century the story has turned on trees.

zh: 1914年，日本人先做了資源調查；
1915年決議開發，開始伐木。
en: In 1914 the Japanese surveyed the forest;
in 1915 they decided to develop it and logging began.

zh: 太平山曾與阿里山、八仙山
並列臺灣三大林場。
en: Taipingshan was once counted with Alishan and Baxianshan
as Taiwan's three great forest stations.

zh: 戰後由國民政府接手，
這裡成為臺灣最大的林場。
en: After the war the Nationalist government took over,
and it became the largest forest station in Taiwan.

zh: 木材靠森林鐵路與索道送下山。
en: Timber came down the mountain by forest railway and cableway.

zh: 山上至今留著伐木時期的索道、
空中纜車與蒸汽集材機。
en: Logging-era cable transport,
an aerial lift and a steam timber hoist still remain on the mountain.

zh: 蹦蹦車的前身是太平山森林鐵路的茂興線，
從太平山莊開到茂興站。
en: The Bong Bong Train began as the Maoxing line of the forest railway,
from Taipingshan Villa to Maoxing station.

zh: 全長約3公里，
行車約20分鐘。
en: The line is about 3 km long,
a ride of about 20 minutes.

zh: 見晴懷古步道，
也是伐木時代留下的路線。
en: The Jiancing Historic Trail
is another route left from the logging days.

zh: 1983年，太平山轉型為森林遊樂區。
en: In 1983 Taipingshan became a forest recreation area.

zh: 山腳的鳩之澤溫泉，
舊名「仁澤溫泉」。
en: At the foot of the mountain, Jiuzhize Hot Spring
was once called Renze.

zh: 往太平山的路上會經過棲蘭森林遊樂區，
距宜蘭市區約38公里。
en: The road up passes Cilan Forest Recreation Area,
about 38 km from Yilan city.

zh: 伐木的山，如今是一片讓人走進森林的山。
en: A mountain once logged is now a mountain for walking into the forest.

title.zh-Hant: 蹦蹦車、溫泉與山上的四季
title.en: The Bong Bong Train, a Hot Spring and Mountain Seasons

tagline.zh-Hant: 林場留下的生活與旅行
tagline.en: Life and travel left by the forest station

zh: 太平山國家森林遊樂區，
有超過百年的歷史。
en: Taipingshan National Forest Recreation Area
has a history of more than a hundred years.

zh: 旅客坐在開放式的蹦蹦車廂裡，
在巨木與林蔭間穿行。
en: Passengers ride in open Bong Bong carriages
under giant trees and deep shade.

zh: 軌道在林間穿梭，
沿途可以看見山巒疊翠。
en: The track threads through the woods,
with layered green ridges along the way.

zh: 遊樂區裡有森林浴步道、森林樂園，
也劃有野生動物保護區。
en: The park has forest-bathing trails and a forest playground,
and a protected area for wildlife.

zh: 春天山上百花盛開；
秋天楓紅，櫻花、梅花與太平山白櫻花依序開放。
en: In spring the mountain is full of flowers;
in autumn the maples turn red, and cherry, plum and white Taipingshan cherry bloom in their seasons.

zh: 秋高氣爽的日子，
這裡有日出與雲海的景色。
en: On clear autumn days
sunrise and seas of cloud are part of the view.

zh: 鳩之澤溫泉是知名的碳酸泉，
舊名「仁澤溫泉」。
en: Jiuzhize is a well-known carbonated spring,
once called Renze.

zh: 溫泉在山腳的溪谷裡，
泉水是碳酸泉。
en: The spring lies in a valley at the foot of the mountains;
its water is naturally carbonated.

zh: 棲蘭森林遊樂區是前往太平山與梨山的必經之地，
園區內有先總統蔣公行館。
en: Cilan is on the way to Taipingshan and Lishan;
it holds a former residence of President Chiang Kai-shek.

zh: 歐式建築的棲蘭山莊與林間小屋，
提供旅客住宿。
en: The European-style Cilan Villa and cabins in the woods
give travellers a bed.

zh: 山上曾經到處是巨木；
鎮安宮後方還留著一片原始林。
en: Giant trees once stood all over the mountain;
a stand of virgin forest remains behind Zhen'an Temple.

zh: 見晴懷古步道與蹦蹦車，
讓人沿著當年伐木的路線走一趟。
en: The Jiancing Historic Trail and the Bong Bong Train
let visitors follow the routes of the logging days.

zh: 過去運木材的路，
如今載著來看森林的人。
en: The routes that once carried timber
now carry people who come to see the forest.

zh: 林場的記憶，
留在軌道、步道與溫泉裡。
en: The memory of the forest station
lives on in its rails, trails and spring.

title.en: Cypress, Beech and the Mikado Pheasant

tagline.zh-Hant: 從亞熱帶到寒帶的森林
tagline.en: Forests from the subtropics to the cold zone

zh: 太平山的海拔從365公尺到2,000公尺，高差很大。
en: Taipingshan runs from 365 to 2,000 metres above the sea, a great range of height.

zh: 從低到高，氣候從亞熱帶
一路變到寒帶。
en: From bottom to top the climate runs from subtropical
all the way to cold.

zh: 這片山林盛產紅檜與扁柏，
曾支撐起整座林場。
en: The forests here are rich in red cypress and Taiwan cypress,
which once kept a whole forest station going.

zh: 往翠峰湖的林道上，
常能看見臺灣獼猴與帝雉。
en: On the forest road to Cuifeng Lake
Taiwan macaques and Mikado pheasants are often seen.

zh: 翠峰湖的另一頭，
生長著國寶級的臺灣山毛櫸。
en: At the far end of Cuifeng Lake
grows the treasured Taiwan beech.

zh: 秋天走上約4公里的步道，
整座山換上一片金黃。
en: In autumn a trail of about 4 km
leads through hills turned to gold.

zh: 翠峰湖周圍的森林，
隨著季節換顏色。
en: The forest around Cuifeng Lake
changes colour with the seasons.

zh: 山上曾經到處是巨木；
鎮安宮後方還有一片原始林。
en: Giant trees once covered the mountain;
virgin forest still stands behind Zhen'an Temple.

zh: 遊樂區裡劃有野生動物保護區。
en: Part of the recreation area is protected for wildlife.

zh: 蹦蹦車沿線，
巨木參天，陽光從林間透下。
en: Along the Bong Bong line
giant trees rise and sunlight filters through.

zh: 秋天楓紅，紫葉槭為山林添上顏色。
en: In autumn the maples turn red, and purple-leaf maples colour the woods.

zh: 溪谷低處的森林，
和山頂的林相完全不同。
en: The forest down in the valley
looks nothing like the forest on the heights.

zh: 從山腳到稜線，
每一段海拔都有各自的森林。
en: From the valley floor to the ridges
every band of height has its own forest.

zh: 伐木停止之後，
森林慢慢回到山的主角。
en: Since logging ended
the forest has slowly become the mountain's main character again.

title.en: A Mountain of Rain and Mist

tagline.zh-Hant: 高山湖泊、溪谷與臺灣最多雨的地方之一
tagline.en: A high lake, deep valleys and some of Taiwan's heaviest rain

zh: 太平山位在宜蘭縣大同鄉，
最高處海拔1,950公尺。
en: Taipingshan lies in Datong, Yilan County;
its highest point is 1,950 metres.

zh: 遊樂區面積一萬兩千多公頃，
橫跨南湖大山山系、三星山山系與大霸尖山支脈。
en: The recreation area covers over 12,000 hectares,
across the Nanhu, Sanxing and Dabajian mountain systems.

zh: 三星山，是園區東側的山系之一。
en: Mount Sanxing anchors one of the mountain systems on the east side.

zh: 翠峰湖海拔約1,840公尺，
是臺灣最大的高山湖泊。
en: Cuifeng Lake lies at about 1,840 metres,
the largest mountain lake in Taiwan.

zh: 湖的四周，是一層層的山稜與森林。
en: All around the lake rise ridge after ridge of forest.

zh: 這裡平均每年下雨約250天，
年雨量約4,007毫米。
en: It rains here on about 250 days a year,
some 4,007 mm in all.

zh: 平均相對濕度高達93.2%，
山上常籠罩在雲霧裡。
en: Average relative humidity is 93.2 per cent,
and the mountain often sits in cloud.

zh: 2016年梅姬颱風，
這裡降下1,015毫米的雨，是當時全臺最高。
en: When Typhoon Megi struck in 2016
it dropped 1,015 mm here, the most in Taiwan.

zh: 測站記錄過的最低溫是零下9.4度，
最高溫是30.6度。
en: The station's record low is minus 9.4 °C,
its record high 30.6 °C.

zh: 沿著溪谷往下，
山腳是鳩之澤溫泉。
en: Down the valley
lies Jiuzhize Hot Spring.

zh: 棲蘭一帶，是往太平山與梨山的入口。
en: Around Cilan the roads to Taipingshan and Lishan begin.

zh: 西邊是雪山山脈，
一道道稜線向遠方延伸。
en: To the west the Xueshan Range
stretches ridge beyond ridge.

zh: 北邊的梵梵山，
俯瞰著溪谷。
en: To the north, Fanfan Shan
looks down over the valley.

zh: 多雨、多霧、高差大，
造就了太平山的森林。
en: Rain, mist and a great range of height
have made Taipingshan's forests.
